grid.attack: FOUR poses in 2 columns x 2 rows
grid.parry: SIX poses in 3 columns x 2 rows

motion.right: slash toward screen RIGHT, then extend right horizontally, retract, return to guard
motion.left: slash toward screen LEFT, extend horizontally LEFT, recover, guard. Nose points left
motion.up: UP attack, rear view entirely from BEHIND: cape covers the back, strike away from camera up and right, then recover. Keep rear camera for EVERY pose
motion.down: DOWN toward viewer attack, camera sees face/chest: first lunge blade down toward viewer, next follow through then draw back sword and guard
motion.parry_ready: ready: progressively lift the shield from low to face protection, hold, brace, settle; blade held low
motion.parry_normal: normal block: shield close to torso absorbing force, weight shifts backward, regain upright guard
motion.parry_perfect: perfect parry: positive decisive outward shield punch (strongest on third frame) then flowing settle; no glitter
motion.parry_failed: failed guard: guard breaks, stagger and buckle deeply forward in frames 3 and 4, rise back to guard
